caveats: LoI captions are abbreviated: they omit catalogue numbers, dimensions and provenance notes ('from a photograph') that the printed under-figure caption carries. They bind the caption core, not the full text.
tier1 spans are proposals read off a scan. Per the firewall they are flagged for keying and must not be adopted as glyph identities.
